Container.Name: uchiyomi
Container.Overview: A self-hosted manga and manhwa reader that also fetches new chapters: discover, grab, monitor, serve and read in one container. Point it at a folder of CBZ/CBR files and read them on any device through a true-black OLED interface built webtoon-first. Installs as a PWA, works offline, per-user progress and favourites, two-factor auth, nightly backups, no account, no telemetry. The database runs inside the container; there is nothing else to install.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: The port you open in a browser.

Config.Name: Library
Config.Description: Your existing CBZ/CBR library. Any folder layout works. Set PUID/PGID to the owner of these files for renames and deletes; otherwise it is read-only.

Config.Name: Data (embedded database)
Config.Description: Postgres lives here. Back it up like any appdata, or rely on the nightly dump in Backups.

Config.Name: Backups
Config.Description: Nightly database and config dumps. Ideally a different disk from Data.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: Run as this user id (Unraid's nobody is 99). Use the owner of your library to allow renames and deletes.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Run as this group id (Unraid's users is 100).

Config.Name: PUBLIC_ORIGIN
Config.Description: How you reach it, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:8080 or https://manga.example.com. Must match, or logins and cookies break.

Config.Name: FLARESOLVERR_URL
Config.Description: A FlareSolverr instance for Cloudflare-protected sources, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:8191. Optional.

Config.Name: SUWAYOMI_URL
Config.Description: A Suwayomi server for Mihon/Tachiyomi extensions, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:4567. Leave empty to go without extensions.

Config.Name: BACKUP_KEEP
Config.Description: How many nightly backups to keep.
